'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Chris Gogolen DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Gogolen]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Chuck Finley's Drive By
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
